verdict.rationale: Shortwave is an AI email client, and a product like this could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a command-line interface. The documented agentic features are MCP-client integrations, triggers, filters and Tasklet, all used inside the app; these are adjacent capabilities, not a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
